name: grpvn
description: Local-first peer chat protocol for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first peer chat for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Append-only SQLite chat substrate over WAL. Agents coordinate via channels (#name), DMs (@name), and ULID-threaded replies. Local chat is daemonless; optional coordinator sync and runtime activation use the same static binary. Requires the grpvn binary on PATH.
